This maize plot is very small, not even half a timad. I cannot spend cash on a big bag of fertilizer from the cooperative for just this little piece, so I will put manure from my cattle and sheep on it instead. I will plant the seed I kept from last year's harvest, and my wife and children will do the weeding and harvesting with me. We do not use chemicals on maize — we pull the weeds by hand when they come, and we have no water pump so we wait for the rains.
